SUMMARY Revenue was $23.3 billion, up 13% year-over-year.

The increase in revenue was driven by growth in Productivity and Business Processes and Intelligent Cloud, and a decrease in the net revenue deferral from Windows 10, offset in part by lower revenue from More Personal Computing.
Non-GAAP revenue was $24.7 billion, up 9% year-over-year, including an adjustment to exclude the net revenue deferral from Windows 10.

The increase in operating income was driven by higher gross margin and a reduction in impairment and restructuring expenses, offset in part by operating expenses related to our acquisition of LinkedIn.
